content:
If you love the new wallpaper Apple designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use it—you can download it right here now.

Download the all-new iPhone 18 Pro wallpaper

Although the default iOS wallpaper is dynamic and changes in response to your device's movement and gestures, what we're offering below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 release candidate.

This release candidate doesn't appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks—possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background via the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're on an iOS device).

Want to see 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event? Tap here.
